bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: West Highland White Terrier owners tracking 12-16 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row West Highland White Terrier schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for West Highland White Terrier handling: Terrier attitude; itchy Westies need dermatology plans, not only shampoo roulette.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the West Highland White Terrier dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this West Highland White Terrier core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed West Highland White Terrier boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.

Bring prior dates for every West Highland White Terrier row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.

If rabies was the missed West Highland White Terrier item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next West Highland White Terrier kennel reservation.

faqs.question: When does the West Highland White Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my West Highland White Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read West Highland White Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
